title: Steering Automated Scientific Discovery via Audited Epistemic Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2611.25214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific discovery requires revisiting the hypotheses in light of new evidence and identifying promising directions beyond those already explored. However, research agents often make claims that are not supported by their observations, explore a narrow hypothesis space, and retain beliefs despite recognizing conflicting evidence. These failures motivate the search for an explicit epistemic state that captures both beliefs about existing hypotheses and directions for further exploration. To this end, we propose Epistemic Compass (EpiCompass), a plug-and-play scaffold that maintains this state through an epistemic tree linking hypotheses, evidence, beliefs, and revisions. translated_title: 通过审计式认知探索引导自动化科学发现
translated_abstract: 科学发现需要根据新证据重新审视假设，并识别已探索范围之外有前景的方向。然而，研究智能体常常做出其观察结果无法支持的主张，探索狭窄的假设空间，并且在意识到证据相互冲突时仍然保留原有信念。这些失败促使人们寻找一种显式的认知状态，以同时捕捉关于现有假设的信念和进一步探索的方向。为此，我们提出了 Epistemic Compass（EpiCompass），这是一种即插即用的脚手架，通过一棵连接假设、证据、信念与修订的认知树来维护这一状态。随着调查的推进，EpiCompass 会根据积累的证据重新评估已探索的假设，并利用未解决的冲突和未探索的方向来引导假设生成。它通过预期认知增益来选择候选假设，同时兼顾……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出即插即用的认知脚手架 EpiCompass，通过维护连接假设、证据、信念与修订的认知树，依据积累证据审计信念、利用未解决冲突和未探索方向生成假设，并以预期认知增益选择候选假设，从而解决自动科研智能体信念缺乏证据支持、假设空间狭窄和忽视矛盾证据的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EpiCompass, a plug-and-play epistemic scaffold that maintains an epistemic tree linking hypotheses, evidence, beliefs, and revisions, auditing beliefs against accumulated evidence, using unresolved conflicts and unexplored directions to guide hypothesis generation, and selecting candidates by anticipated epistemic gain to steer automated scientific discovery.
